solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id, id, moving_avg
FROM (
  SELECT s.customer_id, i.id, i.issued_at,
         ROUND(AVG(i.amount) OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.customer_id
           ORDER BY i.issued_at, i.id
           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ), 2) AS moving_avg
  FROM invoices i
  JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
) averaged
ORDER BY customer_id, issued_at, id;

ambiguities.phrase: Round the average to two decimal places.
ambiguities.readingChosen: ROUND on numeric, which rounds half away from zero.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Float rounding or round-half-to-even. The sample has no half-cent ties, so the output is unaffected.

notes: ROWS 2 PRECEDING frame ordered by (issued_at, id). Averages of two and three values are exact to the cent or repeat, so no tie arises on the sample.
